title: LG-POWERLOG129-TAGBANK: uniform power-log arity, quantum sqrt(n)/log²(n) exponent, linear classical space

claims.statement: For the single fixed uniform LG-POWERLOG129-TAGBANK physical algorithm supplied completely in proof.md and virtual.md (finite tester when ell=ceil(log2 n)<2^20; otherwise h=ceil(ell^(1/8)), f=2^h, q=f, w=min{u:f²u²>=2nh}, y=ceil(n/((f-h)w))+1 and the explicit variable-height MERGEG with enlarged Cap/D, full-b-bit root-record filter, exact source caps, both full-modulus decoders and counted bit-code implementation), for every N>=2 and secret s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), unconditional WHOLE-secret success is at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. Jointly on EVERY branch T=O(2^(sqrt(n)*(log2 n)^(1/8))), ordinary classical space O(n), full allocated quantum space O(2^(sqrt(n)*(log2 n)^(-2))) and total source acquisitions O(2^(sqrt(n)*(log2 n)^(1/8))). Every failure, discard, partial attempt, guard, retry, abort, initialization, finite exact epoch repair, source move, full address debit and cleanup is included with absolute constants and exact exponent coefficients1. The time upper envelope has exact index1/2.
